attrs.quote: If any difficulty arises in giving effect to the provisions of this Act, the Central Government may, by order published in the Official Gazette
attrs.note: Absent: S.O. 5458(E), dated 5 October 2026, is reported by secondary sources to change wording in sections 9(1) and 10(2)(c)(ii). Its gazette copy was not located, so its text and date are unconfirmed. The quote is section 43(1).
